Title: 3 Everyday Foods That Make Varicose Veins Worse

Description:
Been on your feet all day at work, and your leg veins look more twisted by the time you get home? Leg veins have to push blood all the way back up to your heart, and some everyday foods make that job harder - low-fiber white bread, salty processed food, and wine or other alcohol can all add pressure on your veins.

None of them need to disappear for good - small swaps in what you eat and drink can help.

Watch to find out why, and what to try instead.
